description: Source code for translating FAPI PUSCH PDUs to internal PHY representation, including filling codeword, RB allocation, and UCI parameters.

methods.name: fill_codeword
methods.description: Fills the codeword description in the PUSCH PDU if present.

methods.name: fill_rb_allocation
methods.description: Fills the resource block allocation in the PUSCH PDU.

methods.name: fill_uci
methods.description: Fills the UCI parameters in the PUSCH PDU, including handling UCI part2.

methods.name: convert_pusch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts an FAPI PUSCH PDU to internal PHY representation, filling all relevant fields.
